name: Meadow Carousel
design_intent:
MEADOW MILE #20 — the tail-end mover finale: two big static trampoline islands separated by a WIDE 1500px chasm, bridged by ONE slow NON-LETHAL moving hay-cart deck that shuttles across it, plus a central spring throne. The cart carries riders (it never kills; a rider carried off-stage dies to the void, not the deck). Fighting on and around the moving deck is the send-off skill before the industrial circuits. Their gap is far wider than any bounce; the cart is the safe route, a super the risky alt.

GEOMETRY: LEFT island (trampoline x0..1400 top1080) / RIGHT island (trampoline x2900..4300 top1080), a WIDE 1500px void chasm (x1400..2900) between them. ONE moving_platform hay-cart (vehicle:false, w420 h56, centre x2150 y1080, axis 0 deg, amplitude 640, period 5.0, dwell .14) shuttles the chasm x1510..2790, coming ~110px from each island edge at the ends of its travel. One central spring THRONE (x1970..2330 top560 h48) hovers 520px above the islands over the cart lane. Full-width lethal void (rim y1260); bounds -560..4860, ~560px side runway; bottom y1920 = 712px recovery sky.

MOVEMENT (Tuning.gd: trampoline apex 270 / bubblegum 180 / spring 480; zero-boost drift ~395 tramp / ~527 spring max; normal_boost_max 760 crosses ~680 in ~1s; super 2800 clears all, dumps tank):
- CROSS the 1500px chasm: far beyond any bounce (max spring drift 527) and beyond a single normal-boost hop -> RIDE THE CART (hop onto it ~110px off an island edge, ride, hop off ~110px from the far edge) OR spend a full SUPER as a risky one-shot. NORMAL BOOST/SUPER REQUIRED; miss = fall into the void. Verb: FLY.
- REACH the CART at mid-lane: the deck sits over open void, so mounting/dismounting it is a boosted-air play, never a bounce. Verb: FLY.
- CLIMB to the THRONE (top560): 520px above the islands (1080). Trampoline apex 270 reaches y810 -> 270px short. JETPACK CLIMB REQUIRED. Verb: FLY.
- RECOVER: island bottom (1208) to bottom blast (1920) = 712px recovery sky (>= 650); ride the cart off-stage or get carried past a lip and you fall (the deck never kills, the void does). Verb: FLY.
- The chasm dwarfs a spring bounce's reach and the throne sits above spring apex, so flight (or the cart) is required to cross or climb. Vertical AND horizontal distance are load-bearing.

BACKDROP NOTE: the plan lists an optional new meadow_bloom painting; ships JSON-ONLY today on meadow_day (blue sky + clouds + hills), the art is a later polish swap.
